description:
About our brand and products:

LinX Vista is a continuous glucose monitoring system powered by MicroTech Medical, a CE-certified medical device manufacturer. Our sensor transmits real-time glucose readings directly to your smartphone via Bluetooth — no scanning required. Each sensor lasts 15 days, records glucose data every minute, and is IP68 waterproof for worry-free wear during showers, swimming, and workouts.


What makes us different:

We've engineered one of the smallest and lightest CGM sensors on the market — just 22mm in diameter, 4+mm thin, and weighing only 2.16g. With an industry-leading MARD of 8.66% (lower is better), our accuracy meets CE standards (MARD <10%). One-step insertion is simple and nearly painless. 


How affiliates can earn:

You earn 15%–20% commission on every successful sale you refer — well above the industry average of 10–15%. With a 30-day cookie window, any purchase made within 30 days after a user clicks your link qualifies. Payments are sent monthly via PayPal. We also support coupon-based tracking, giving you flexible promotion options.


How to promote us:

Share your unique affiliate link or custom discount coupons across blogs, social media (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), email newsletters, and health/wellness communities. Hot content angles include "CGMs for metabolic health," "blood sugar tracking for fitness optimization," "CGMs beyond diabetes," and "real-time glucose insights for better energy and focus." 


Eligible countries for commission:

We currently ship to the following 13 countries only. 

Switzerland, Croatia, Norway, Hungary, Slovakia, Cyprus, Greece, Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, Australia, Mexico, Colombia.


Medical compliance (mandatory for all affiliates):

By promoting LinX Vista CGMs, you agree to include the following disclaimer clearly and visibly in all your promotional content (e.g., blog posts, social media captions, video descriptions, email newsletters):

This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

Always consult your healthcare provider before making medical decisions.

Designed for individuals aged 2 years and older. The system must be applied, operated, and the data interpreted by a competent adult on behalf of the intended user.

Not evaluated for: Pregnant women, peritoneal dialysis patients, patients with implanted pacemakers, patients with coagulation disorders or those taking anticoagulant drugs.

For important safety information, contraindications, and warnings, please refer to our Safety Information page.

You must not claim or imply that LinX Vista CGMs is suitable for the populations listed as "not evaluated for" above. Failure to include this disclaimer or making false suitability claims may result in termination of your affiliate account and withholding of unpaid commissions.


Other information:

Affiliates from any country may register (no regional limit on applications), but commissions are only paid for orders shipped to the 13 eligible countries listed above. Applications are reviewed manually to ensure quality and compliance. Join us to tap into the fast-growing metabolic health market with a clinically validated, user-friendly product.

  • Net product subtotal under €100: 10% commission.
  • Net product subtotal €100 and above: 15% commission.

5) Attribution window

A sale is eligible for commission if it is correctly tracked and attributed to you within 30 days from the customer’s click on your affiliate link, subject to the rules in these Terms (including returns/cancellations).

6) Returns, cancellations, refunds & chargebacks (30-day policy; validation and clawback)

We offer a 30-day return/refund window. Commissions are payable only on valid, completed and non-refunded orders.

If an order is cancelled, refunded, or charged back, any related commission will be voided; if a commission has already been paid for a later-refunded or charged-back order, we may deduct (claw back) the commission amount from future payouts.

We may keep commissions in a pending/validation status until the 30-day return/refund period has passed.

Payout frequency: Monthly (after validation)

Minimum payout threshold: €50

Affiliates are responsible for any PayPal fees, exchange rate spreads, or taxes applicable to their commissions.

8) Coupons and discount codes

Coupon codes may be promoted only if they are provided or explicitly published by the Company for the Program.

You may not promote unauthorized coupons, "found" codes, or create misleading discount claims.

9) Email marketing (permitted with restrictions)

Email promotion is permitted only to your own subscribers (people who have opted in to receive your marketing).

You must not purchase, scrape, rent, or otherwise use third-party lists, and you must comply with all applicable anti-spam/marketing laws and platform policies.

Because we sell CGMS/medical-related products, strict safety and claims rules apply.

10.2 Age and supervision statements (where relevant). Where your content discusses suitability, intended users, or use scenarios, you must state:

You must not state or imply that the product cures, treats, prevents disease, replaces professional medical advice, guarantees outcomes, or is "clinically proven" unless you are using Company-provided, Company-approved wording and evidence.
